Balkan Underdogs is a “non profit” UK registered dog rescue charity made up of volunteers dedicated to helping the street dogs of The Balkans.
Please consider one of our dogs, we fight against the odds and without our supporters we wouldn’t be able to help those in need most!!!


Why adopt from us?
There is no animal welfare here in the Balkans. Dogs rarely live long, as they're cruelly treated by people, poisoned and left to die, or caught regularly by dog catchers and destroyed in the worse possible ways. So our small rescue team are fighting to make a difference to some of these dogs, and by adopting you are saving a life, a real rescue.

Email/message us via the website (http://balkanunderdogs.org.uk)
